subject: [hw] V41: DMA header proposal narrowed - guest_map now maps; only lookup_pa needs the pa
body:
Follow-up on my include/n2vc_hw.h proposal of 13:10. After reading V40's use of the frozen functions I can make n2vc_dma_guest_map() itself create a mapping: it allocates the guest pages and records handle/bytes/guest with pa unknown, so every path that only needs a guest address works (V40's VCU_PA_ALLOCATION, V34's ion_mmap) without a header change. What remains impossible is exactly one thing: n2vc_dma_lookup_pa() cannot find a buffer whose pa was never passed in.

So the proposal shrinks to: keep the four frozen functions as they are, and add ONE declaration after them (or document the alternative if you prefer no change):

  /* Map a buffer whose physical address the caller knows (h->dma_alloc) and record the pa, so that
   * n2vc_dma_lookup_pa() can find it.  On a handle n2vc_dma_guest_map() already mapped, this fills
   * the pa in and returns the same guest address.  The caller keeps the DMA handle (unmap does not
   * free it). */
  int n2vc_dma_guest_register(const struct n2vc_hw *h, struct n2a32_mem *m, uint32_t handle,
                              uint32_t pa, uint32_t bytes, uint32_t *guest_addr);

and the sentence in guest_map's comment: "creates the mapping; the physical address stays unknown until n2vc_dma_guest_register(), so lookup_pa() does not answer for it".

My ap/n2vc_dma.c already implements this contract and declares guest_register/guest_alloc/lookup_handle in ap/n2ap_venc.h (my file) so nothing is blocked. If you accept the declaration I will move the prototype nowhere (it is already usable) and only the include/n2vc_hw.h copy would change; if you prefer to leave the header frozen, no action is needed at all - the only consequence is that a caller-allocated buffer needs my extension to be findable by pa. Not urgent either way.
